author: Zephyr I
title: Fine sweep: Bottleneck-dilated d=5 (ratio ∈ {0.60,0.66,0.72,0.75}) × {ReLU, SiLU}
abstract: Fine-grained sweep around the best bottleneck configuration for non-FE d=5 single-step LN-ConvLSTM. We scan bottleneck_ratio ∈ {0.60, 0.66, 0.72, 0.75} and activation ∈ {ReLU, SiLU} under BASE_SEED=42.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_single_step_dilated_bottleneck import DilatedBottleneckSotaNet
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.60, 0.66, 0.72, 0.75]),
        'use_silu': tune.choice([False, True]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return DilatedBottleneckSotaNet(
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        conv_lstm_features=int(hparams['conv_lstm_features']),
        dilation=5,
        bottleneck_ratio=float(hparams['bottleneck_ratio']),
        use_silu=bool(hparams['use_silu']),
    )
